title: Data Engineer (AWS)
description:
Senior Data Engineer - Contract

Rate: £475 per day
IR35: Outside IR35
Location: Fully Remote (UK)
Start: ASAP

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to support a major digital transformation programme.

You will be responsible for designing, building and optimising scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain data pipelines using AWS and Apache Spark.

  • Develop and optimise ETL/ELT processes.

  • Design data models and improve data warehouse performance.

  • Ensure data quality, security and governance.

  • Collaborate with engineering and technical teams.

Essential Skills

  • Strong AWS experience (Glue, S3, Lambda, Redshift, Athena, Step Functions).

  • Apache Spark, Apache Iceberg and dbt.

  • Advanced SQL and data warehousing.

  • ETL/ELT pipeline development.

  • Java and relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server).

  • Experience with Git and Agile delivery.

  • Previous UK Government / Public Sector experience (essential).

  • Must be eligible for SC Clearance.
